data.one_liner: Order items inside a Stack widget using a z-index approach
data.what_it_does: Provides an Indexed and Indexer widget that allows you to control the display order of items inside a Stack, similar to the CSS z-index property. Items can be wrapped in an Indexed widget or implement IndexedInterface.
use_when: You need to change the stacking order of overlapping widgets inside a Stack dynamically or statically
You want an easy z-index style ordering system for Flutter UI elements
avoid_when: You are not using a Stack widget
Standard Stack children ordering is sufficient for your design
strengths: Simplifies z-index style management for Stack widgets
Supports multiple ways of usage via Indexed widget or IndexedInterface implementation
weaknesses: Not recently updated beyond early Flutter 3 support
